name: The Guide

source.note: A side quest boss of our own (The Guide to the Temple, docs/story/side_quests.md): a mountain guide who took a gift from something in the Amber Temple long ago, a year of life for every family he brings to its door. Built on the 2025 Monster Manual's warlock-like casters at CR 10: an ice axe and bolts of amber light, a whiteout, Hold Person and Cone of Cold once a day, shadows that stand up off the snow, Legendary Resistance and two Legendary Actions. Drawn with the scout's sprite.

ac_note: furs, and something hard as amber under the skin

traits.name: Legendary Resistance (2/Day)
traits.summary: Twice a day, a failed saving throw becomes a success.
traits.text: When the Guide fails a saving throw, he can choose to succeed instead, twice a day.

traits.name: The Mountain's Own
traits.summary: He's never cold and never lost. Something in the amber pays him a year for every family he brings to its door.
traits.text: Long ago the Guide took a gift from something sealed in the Amber Temple: he is never cold, never lost on the mountain, and every family he brings to the temple's door buys him another year. He was born before the count came over the mountains.

actions.name: Multiattack
actions.summary: An Ice Axe and an Amber Bolt.
actions.text: The Guide makes one Ice Axe attack and one Amber Bolt attack.

actions.name: Ice Axe
actions.summary: A climber's axe, rimed with frost that doesn't melt.
actions.text: Melee Attack Roll: +8, reach 5 ft. Hit: 8 (1d8 + 4) Slashing damage plus 10 (3d6) Cold damage.

actions.name: Amber Bolt
actions.summary: A bolt of thick golden light that feels like being swallowed.
actions.text: Ranged Attack Roll: +8, range 120 ft. Hit: 18 (4d8) Necrotic damage.

actions.name: Whiteout
actions.summary: Recharge 5-6: the snow comes up round three creatures within 60 ft; DC 16 Con save, 4d8 Cold and Blinded until the end of his next turn, half damage on a success.
actions.text: Constitution Saving Throw: DC 16, up to three creatures the Guide can see within 60 feet. Failure: 18 (4d8) Cold damage, and the target has the Blinded condition until the end of the Guide's next turn. Success: Half damage only.

actions.name: Spellcasting
actions.summary: Hold Person and Cone of Cold, once a day each (Cha, DC 16).
actions.text: The Guide casts one of the following spells, using Charisma as the spellcasting ability (spell save DC 16): once a day each, Hold Person and Cone of Cold.

options.name: Sure-Footed
options.summary: Moves up to half his Speed without provoking Opportunity Attacks.

summary: A lean, smiling mountain guide in furs who goes bareheaded in the snow. Something in the Amber Temple pays him a year of life for every family he brings to its door, and he has brought a great many.
